_comment: Voice-profile catalog for the LAIONBox engine. Each profile is a Gemini TTS voice identity with per-language reference clips in assets/voice_profiles/<voice>/<lang>.mp3 (extracted from the laion/gemini-2.5-pro-tts-voice-profiles dataset, judged & selected by scripts/extract_voice_profiles.py + judge_voice_profiles.py). Profile display names are standard human names; `voice` is the original Gemini voice = the folder name. The LLM (wizard/forge) picks profiles using gender/age/timbre.

Anna.timbre: Bright, expressive voice with medium pitch, warm clear tone and conversational pace.

Amy.timbre: Soft, gentle female voice with a warm, breathy texture and slow, reflective pace

Bella.timbre: soft, breathy, warm, mid-pitched, hesitant pace with a gentle and clear texture

Chloe.timbre: warm, clear, slightly breathy female voice with moderate pitch and expressive pace

Daisy.timbre: Warm, moderately pitched, soft texture, relaxed and slightly breathy delivery with reflective pace

Erin.timbre: low pitch, warm, slightly breathy, measured pace, intimate, soft texture

Kira.timbre: bright, engaging, slightly breathy tone, conversational pace, natural pitch

Lucy.timbre: Soft, warm, low-pitched voice with a slow, contemplative, and clear delivery

Lily.timbre: Soft, breathy, youthful female voice with a warm, gentle, and slow-paced delivery

Zoe.timbre: soft, slow-paced, slightly breathy, thoughtful, medium pitch, clear pronunciation

Aaron.timbre: deep, warm, resonant, with a gravelly texture and a slow, relaxed pace

Alec.timbre: Warm, low-pitched voice with a slightly gravelly texture and slow, reflective pace
Alec.good_for: charming hosts, restaurant owners, romantic leads

Axel.timbre: Deep, warm voice with a slightly gravelly texture, slow contemplative pace, breathy delivery

Charlie.timbre: Warm, low-pitched, slightly breathy, relaxed conversational pace, intimate and clear tone

Ethan.timbre: deep, resonant, warm, clear, measured pace, steady delivery, smooth texture

Finn.timbre: Soft, gentle pitch, warm and breathy texture, slow contemplative pace
Finn.good_for: enthusiastic students, sports fans, dramatic moments

Ian.timbre: Warm, relaxed, mid-pitched male voice with a gentle, clear, conversational pace

Oscar.timbre: low-pitched, warm, breathy texture, slow and deeply reflective pace

Peter.timbre: medium-low pitch, warm, slightly breathy, soft texture, reflective and moderate pace
Peter.good_for: cheerful friends, comic relief, mischievous characters

Ray.timbre: Deep, warm masculine voice with a slightly gravelly texture and slow, contemplative pace

Miles.timbre: Deep, warm, low-pitched with a slightly raspy, slow-paced, and breathy quality
